title: What LLM Agents See and What Users Say
abstract: arXiv:2611.17639v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Before an LLM agent cancels a reservation or deletes a folder for a user, what stops it from acting on a false assumption: what its tools show, or what the user says? In this work, we study this gap with presupposition theory from linguistics: an agent may act only if each claim behind the act (e.g., one reservation fits the name) is seen to hold, answered by the user, or disclosed while the act can be undone. A simple bound shows that when lookups cannot tell one record from two, any agent acts without asking first as often with two records as with one. We then vary whether a search lists, counts, or omits a second match, and whether the user states a claim that a record refutes (e.g., "It is empty"). Under a role-only prompt, a count of a second record leaves most of 36 earlier agents acting on the one they see, whereas listing both stops most. When the user says a record such as a folder is empty, however, a count of its one item stop

translated_title: LLM智能体所见与用户所言
translated_abstract: 在LLM智能体为用户取消预订或删除文件夹之前，是什么阻止它基于错误假设采取行动：是其工具所显示的内容，还是用户所说的话？在这项工作中，我们借助语言学中的预设理论来研究这一差距：智能体只有在行动背后的每个命题（例如，一个预订恰好对应一个名字）被观察到成立、得到用户的回应，或在行动可撤销的前提下被披露时，才可以行动。一个简单的界限表明，当查询无法区分一条记录与两条记录时，任何智能体在存在两条记录时与只有一条记录时一样，都会不加询问就直接行动。随后，我们改变搜索结果是列出、计数还是省略第二个匹配项，以及用户是否陈述了会被记录反驳的声明（例如，“它是空的”）。在仅使用角色提示的情况下，对第二条记录的计数会导致36个早期智能体中的大多数仍然只对其所看到的那一条采取行动，而列出两条记录则能阻止大多数智能体的错误行动。然而，当用户声称某条记录（如文件夹）为空时，对其唯一一条项目的计数会……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究运用语言学预设理论系统分析了LLM智能体在工具输出与用户陈述冲突时的行动边界，发现只有当搜索结果明确“列出”多个匹配项时才能阻止大多数智能体基于错误假设行动，而仅“计数”或依赖用户声明则不足以防止误操作。
en_tdlr: This work applies linguistic presupposition theory to study when LLM agents act on false assumptions, showing that explicitly listing multiple matching records stops most agents from acting incorrectly, whereas merely counting matches or relying on user claims does not.
